books.title: Macmillan · Improve your Skills: Reading for IELTS 6.0–7.5
Proper English School · 80 IELTS Listening Tests
books.note: Daily tests are in the to-do list

tasks.label: Reading: one article + 8–10 new words
tasks.sub: BBC Future / Guardian / Aeon / The Conversation, 700–900 words · a one-line heading for every paragraph · each word: meaning, sentence from the text, your own sentence

tasks.label: Full Reading test (60 min) + analysis
tasks.sub: Exam conditions, no pauses · then every mistake into Mistakes with question type + cause · write the paraphrases

tasks.label: Listening · 80 IELTS Listening Tests · Test 1–5 (Part 1)
tasks.sub: One listen, no pauses · check with the key · replay every mistake 3× and write what you hear · cause: spelling / number / plural -s / word limit / changed answer / not heard
